w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (The Congregation, Big Big, The Mountain Lord, Spool) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ines just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (The Algorithm, Old Gavel, Big-Eyes, Big Loud, The Callback) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
firstContext:
⚠️ 1 threats: Big-Eyes 1 (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Olivia, Sam, Petra, Henry, Monica. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
You walk in open-handed, talking — low, steady, unafraid. And impossibly, they listen. They stand down. (Walk In: the fight ends.)
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
